items.title: Sadie Goodson Interview, 1984-12-12
items.q: I played with him the first time I played... His piano played with six, Helen Jackson her name was. And she asked me would I go and play in her place that night. But I only played maybe one night with them.

ctx.x: No, I didn't play with him but I remember when he came there. Now I played with another band that belonged in Pensacola, that was Butsy Douglas. What's his name? Butsy Douglas. Butsy. I played with him the first time I played, he was the first band I played with before I got with P.T. and them. His piano played with six, Helen Jackson her name was. And she asked me would I go and play in her place that night. But I only played maybe one night with them.
Yeah. How about Punch Miller, excuse me. Punch Miller, do you remember Punch coming there?
